title: Fix exports failing on accented names
body:
## In plain terms

Exports fail for people whose names contain an accent. They see an error page instead of a file, and have to ask support for the data. This started after the last release.

## Context

Support logged several reports this week. The export writes the file with the system code page instead of UTF-8.

## Acceptance Criteria

- An export with an accented name downloads and opens with the name intact.
- Existing exports are unchanged.

## AI prompt

Write the CSV export as UTF-8 in the export writer and add a test.
Verify: the export tests pass.
